INSERT INTO survey_answer ( response_id, question_id, answer_text, answer_options, answer_rating, answer_date ) VALUES
( #{responseId}, #{a.questionId}, #{a.answerText},
#{a.answerOptions}::jsonb NULL , #{a.answerRating}, #{a.answerDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, response_id, question_id, answer_text, answer_options::text AS answer_options, answer_rating, answer_date FROM survey_answer WHERE response_id = #{responseId} ORDER BY id

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.question_text AS question_text, q.question_type AS question_type, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_response sr WHERE sr.survey_id = #{surveyId} AND sr.submitted_at IS NOT NULL ) AS total_responses, COUNT(sa.id) AS answer_count, sa.answer_text AS answer_text, sa.answer_options::text AS answer_options, sa.answer_rating AS answer_rating, sa.answer_date AS answer_date FROM survey_question q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.id, a.question_id, a.answer_text, a.answer_options, a.answer_rating, a.answer_date FROM survey_answer a JOIN survey_response r ON r.id = a.response_id AND r.submitted_at IS NOT NULL ) sa ON sa.question_id = q.id WHERE q.survey_id = #{surveyId} GROUP BY q.id, q.question_text, q.question_type, q.sort_order, sa.answer_text, sa.answer_options, sa.answer_rating, sa.answer_date ORDER BY q.sort_order, q.id
